_comment: Tier-2 for sparta rarefied_flow: 'compute temp' does not subtract the streaming velocity, so it reports T_thermal + m|vstream|^2/(3 kB). The fixture measures the offset against that formula for argon at 1000 m/s and confirms it is negligible at 10 m/s — the inflation scales with species mass and the SQUARE of the stream speed, so 'compute temp is always wrong in a flow' would be the wrong lesson. 'compute thermal/grid' removes the per-cell mean and stays thermal. Both runs exit 0 with no warning.
